name: Moby
note: Italian ferry company (Sardegna, Sicilia, Corsica, Isola d'Elba routes). The club's announcement names Achille Onorato as Moby's CEO and Alessandro Onorato as sales manager, and describes Moby as family-owned; ultimate ownership not traced with a claim. Back-of-shirt sponsor of Parma Calcio since 2025/26.
